== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[The Camp (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1272_26</code>, Virtual Block 7 slip 76), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 7.2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p4-76-The_Camp.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-thecamp-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[The Camp (V)]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words (pilot icon, ▲, Immune to Alter) are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Unless your [Reflections 2] objective on table, deploy on table. If [Permanent Weapon] Maul in battle at a site, and you have no unique (•) characters of ability > 3 (except Luke of ability = 4) there, lightsabers there may not be ‘swung’ twice. Once per game, may ▲ one K’lor’slug or a [Setup] card. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1272_26</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-p4-76-The_Camp-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B27 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
